text:
ITEM 1 | Whole fresh spinach-like leaves, dark green, glossy and slightly wilted, with pale green stems and visible veins, fanned out on the left side of the plate; leaves about 8-12 cm long, covering roughly 25% of the plate footprint, flat with low height | 60
ITEM 2 | Finely chopped dark green leafy greens (kale-like), tightly packed, slightly moist, with a matte texture and small pale crumbles scattered through; mound about 10 cm across, 1.5 cm high, covering roughly 20% of the plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Cubes of pale cream-to-golden firm pieces, about 1.5-2 cm each, with slightly browned edges and a dry, soft-crumbly surface, scattered among the greens and at the lower edge of the mound | 35
ITEM 4 | Cooked brown lentils, small olive-brown round grains, glossy and moist with a light oily coating, mixed in a cluster about 8 cm by 6 cm, 1 cm high, in the lower right of the plate | 70
ITEM 5 | Halved and diced red tomato pieces, bright red with glossy skin and juicy cut faces, roughly 1-2 cm, mixed in with the lentils at the lower right | 30
ITEM 6 | Small bits of golden-brown cooked cubes, slightly crisp and browned, dispersed among the lentils and tomatoes at the lower right | 20
ITEM 7 | Small wilted fresh spinach leaves, dark green, flat and glossy, a few pieces tucked beside the lentils at the lower right edge, about 5 cm long | 15
